hooks.command: git fetch --prune origin; git worktree prune; for b in $(git branch --merged main | grep -v '^\*' | grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*(main|master)[[:space:]]*$'); do git branch -d "$b" 2>/dev/null; done; current=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); if [ "$current" = "main" ]; then git pull origin main; else git fetch origin main:main 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Syncing main and pruning merged branches before worktree creation...
